Hobgoblin Shieldguard (CV 22)

A disciplined soldier carries a rectangular shield painted with the names of former squadmates.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 18 · Speed: 5 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage

ManeuversEffect

Opportunity AttackBasic Melee

Details

Ranked spear

Target: One visible creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 3. Standard defense: Push 1.

Limit: Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

Shield Hunker

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, spend its Reaction to impose 1 Bane on player attacks it can block until the start of its next turn. The DA judges blockability. Stacks with Defend through normal Boon/Bane rules, not with another activation of itself.

Cover a Companion

The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Brace the approach and use the spear to push foes out of formation. Keep the shield Reaction for a consequential blockable attack.

Encounter and conversation: The guard's orders require protecting civilians, creating leverage against a reckless commander.

Habitat: Settlement; frontier; contested road · Communication: Common and its community’s language

Loot: Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
